function: Pre-beamforming (beam and RF-chain selection from a DFT codebook) via budgeted combinatorial MAB, maximizing cumulative received energy under the UAV battery budget (pp. 3-4).
system: Downlink UAV mmWave MIMO: UAV with N=10x10 antennas, NRF=32 RF chains, K=15 single-antenna users; solar-powered, battery 0.05 J; mmWave band (no frequency given); no RIS (pp. 2, 5).
method: Reinforcement learning: budgeted combinatorial multi-armed bandit with discounted UCB, learned from historical data; stage 2 multi-user beamformer is convex optimization (CVX), not learned (pp. 1, 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rician channel with one-ring NLoS model, distance path loss beta0 d^-alpha, Rician factor 10, angular spread 5 degrees; no standard model or dataset (pp. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Bandit learns over T=200 slots in the simulated scenario; sweeps over SNR, number of RF chains, and users (K=10, 15); no train/test split or unseen scenario (p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: full-digital precoding and MBMRF beam selection [7] (multiple beam selection via multiple RF chains). No earlier learned method compared (p. 5).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz) vs SNR and vs number of RF chains; energy efficiency vs RF chains; reward per slot for K=10, 15 (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "We adopt the Rician channel model [12], where the channel" between UAV and user is a custom Rician model with one-ring NLoS and distance path loss; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "different numbers of users, demonstrating that the reward" converges; the paper reports sweeps of users, SNR and RF chains, with no trained model tested in an unseen scenario or after adaptation.
q3_support: p. 5: "both the Full-digital precoding scheme and MBMRF scheme" are the only schemes compared with the proposed one (both non-learned); earlier MAB-based two-stage schemes [10], [11] are cited on p. 1 but not simulated.
q4_support: p. 5: "which can also decrease the hardware" complexity of the UAV is a qualitative remark; no order of complexity, operations, parameters or runtime of the BC-MAB or beamforming algorithm is reported, and pilot overhead is signaling only.
q5_support: p. 5: "we investigate the performance of the proposed TSB scheme" by simulation with its own Rician channels (p. 2) and listed parameters; no link or DOI for code or data, no public dataset, no measured data.
notes: The first page holds the title and DOI. Included although only stage 1 is learned: the paper calls the BC-MAB a reinforcement learning method that learns the pre-beamformer from historical data (p. 1), while stage 2 is convex optimization with CVX (p. 4); the reviewer should confirm that a bandit counts as learned. Area 6 rather than 3 because the more specific area wins and the link is a UAV aerial base station with learned beam and RF-chain control under a battery budget; area 3 also fits (pre-beamformer design). Earlier MAB-based schemes [10], [11] are cited (p. 1) but not compared.
